emails.subject: Daisy Hackathon Project Approval & Guidelines
emails.body:
Hello Arjun,

I have thoroughly reviewed the Smart Mail Notification & Voice Assistant project proposal. The integration of Socket.IO real-time event broadcasting along with browser Speech Synthesis meets all requirements for our BCA Hackathon.

Make sure your presentation highlights the dual database design (MongoDB Atlas with graceful JSON store fallback) and live presence directory.

Best of luck!
Prof. Rohan Nair

emails.subject: Aqua Glassmorphism UI Components Ready!
emails.body:
Hey Arjun! I just pushed the new Frutiger Aero Aqua styling for the mailbox dashboard.

Key highlights:
- Frosted glass cards with backdrop blur
- Electric cyan jelly action buttons
- Voice Assistant reader with sentence chunking and waveform indicators

Let me know if we need to adjust the speech pitch or rate defaults!

emails.subject: Socket.IO Real-Time Dispatch is Live
emails.body:
Hi Priya,

The Socket.IO dispatch system is working perfectly. When you open two browser tabs (one for Arjun, one for Priya) and send a mail, the recipient tab instantly triggers the speech assistant announcement: "You have received a new email from...".

Looking forward to our live demo with the jury!
